diagnostics.message: SSH, Git, HTTP, and Stats task registration is conditional on exact Config.Enabled predicates; the fixture does not choose a runtime configuration.
Server.Shutdown joins its own shutdown tasks, but the serve handler does not explicitly join the outer s.Start task before returning.
The select at cmd/soft/serve/serve.go:111 waits for a server result or signal; it is not represented as a join edge.
